# xterm.js vendor files

These files are bundled with PHAROS so the terminal works without a network connection.

- `xterm.js` and `xterm.css`: `@xterm/xterm` 6.0.0
- `addon-fit.js`: `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.11.0
- Source: jsDelivr npm package endpoints
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`
